scope: Read-only product UI/UX review of the standalone demo. No product source changes or game server connection.

findings.topic: Primary categories and quick contextual detail all open the same blocking dialog.
findings.recommendation: Primary navigation switches the central workspace; quick views retain a short drawer with a link to the full workspace.

findings.topic: Construction management uses the same facility-comparison view as planet details; no current queue in the panel.
findings.recommendation: Construction workspace should show queue, facility list, comparison, resources and prerequisites together.

findings.topic: Defense overview in idle state only shows no threat and omits the existing defense snapshot.
findings.recommendation: Defense overview should remain available independently of a threat.

findings.topic: Mobile facility selection scrolls its picker and focused control outside the viewport.
findings.recommendation: Keep facility selection visible or provide a stable return-to-list mechanism and visible focus.

findings.topic: Browser Back changes navigation history without closing or traversing the detail panel.
findings.recommendation: Define history semantics for major views and nested details.

findings.topic: Landscape construction gets only175px of scrollable content within a480px-wide dialog.
findings.recommendation: Use a full workspace for long workflows and adapt short details to available height.

findings.topic: Prepared/empty screens lack direct next actions and use repeated demo notices.
findings.recommendation: Keep availability clear at entry and add a useful next action where appropriate.

preserve: Quiet visual style and resource units
serviceIntegrationNote: Current local demo intentionally pauses preview time inside a dialog. Real server ETA must not pause when a player opens management UI.
limits: Several categories are summary/unconnected placeholders; real management, message, map and filter workflows cannot be judged yet.
No visit to the existing game root, no live scouting or commands, no real-device/screen-reader certification.
